description: Get a ready-to-sign Solana swap transaction, best-price routed across all DEXs via Jupiter. Non-custodial: you sign with your OWN key and broadcast — StillOS never holds your funds. A 0.25% router fee is embedded (cheaper than Trojan/Photon/GMGN at 0.5-1%). When buying a non-stablecoin token, the response also includes a free on-chain scam-check (mint & freeze authority) so an agent knows before it buys. Returns base64 swapTransaction, expected output, route, and safety verdict.

amount.description: amount of inputMint to swap, in whole units (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5 SOL)

inputMint.description: mint address of the token you are selling, or "SOL"/"USDC"/"USDT"

outputMint.description: mint address of the token you are buying, or "SOL"/"USDC"/"USDT"

userPublicKey.description: the wallet that will sign and pay (your Solana public key)

name: build_solana_swap
